name: lifetag-bench
description: Standalone benchmark suite for the AegisTag/LifeTag paper (docs/lifetag_paper_draft.tex). Independent of client/ and server/ package installs; only depends on Node built-ins plus tsx/typescript to run.

scripts.bench:all: npm run bench:encoding && npm run bench:sensitivity && npm run bench:crypto-latency && npm run bench:tamper && npm run bench:baseline
